"""Sequential fresh-process CLI measurements using Wyn's existing -v timers."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BINARY = ROOT / "target/release/wyn.exe"
TLC = "to_tlc validate_ownership tlc_partial_eval specialize_types inline_unified_helpers extract_stages pin_entry_buffers tlc_monomorphize canonicalize_conditional_producers normalize_soacs expose_runtime_index_producers defunctionalize inline apply_ownership".split()
TIMER = re.compile(r"^([^:\r\n]+): ([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*ms$", re.MULTILINE)
CASES = {
    "tinyporto": ["../tinyporto/wyn/main.wyn", "--graphics", "-O", "--target-double", "rust-wgpu", "--target", "spirv"],
    "fluid": ["fluid-simulation", "--graphics", "--subgroups", "--target", "spirv"],
}
CASES["tinyporto-basic"] = [arg for arg in CASES["tinyporto"] if arg != "-O"]
CASES["fluid-optimized"] = [*CASES["fluid"], "-O"]


def parse(text):
    timings = {}
    for name, value in TIMER.findall(text):
        timings[name] = timings.get(name, 0.0) + float(value)
    return timings


assert parse("load_modules: 12ms\negglog: 23.456 ms\negglog import: starting\n") == {"load_modules": 12.0, "egglog": 23.456}
assert not parse("warning: text\nBuilt file in 3.00s\n")
assert abs(parse("repeated: 1.123 ms\nrepeated: 2.001 ms\n")["repeated"] - 3.124) < 1e-9


def run(name, args, label):
    command = [str(BINARY), "build", *args, "-v", "-o", str(OUT / f"{name}.spv")]
    log_path = OUT / f"{name}-{label}.log"
    print(f"Starting {name} {label}", flush=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    with log_path.open("wb") as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=600)
    wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
    text = log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    from collections import Counter
    record = {"command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "wall_ms": wall_ms, "timings_ms": parse(text), "timer_calls": dict(Counter(name for name, _ in TIMER.findall(text))), "log": log_path.name}
    (OUT / f"{name}-{label}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"Finished {name} {label}: exit={result.returncode}, {wall_ms / 1000:.3f}s", flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(text[-5000:], flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    timings = record["timings_ms"]
    assert all(key in timings for key in ["load_modules", "type_check", *TLC, "egglog", "lower", "write_artifacts"]), timings.keys()
    record["coarse_ms"] = {
        "AST loading and parsing": timings["load_modules"],
        "AST semantic frontend": timings["type_check"],
        "TLC": sum(timings[key] for key in TLC),
        "Egglog through SSA": timings["egglog"],
        "SSA and SPIR-V backend": timings["lower"],
        "Artifact and host emission": timings["write_artifacts"],
    }
    record["coarse_ms"]["Other process time"] = wall_ms - sum(record["coarse_ms"].values())
    return record


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    count = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3
    names = sys.argv[2:] or ["tinyporto", "fluid"]
    os.environ.setdefault("RUST_MIN_STACK", "67108864")
    records = {name: [] for name in names}
    for name in names:
        run(name, CASES[name], "warmup")
    for index in range(1, count + 1):
        for name in names:
            records[name].append(run(name, CASES[name], str(index)))
    summary = {}
    for name, runs in records.items():
        summary[name] = {"runs": runs, "median_wall_ms": statistics.median(r["wall_ms"] for r in runs)}
        for key in ("coarse_ms", "timings_ms"):
            summary[name]["median_" + key] = {phase: statistics.median(r[key][phase] for r in runs) for phase in runs[0][key]}
        print(name, json.dumps(summary[name]["median_coarse_ms"], indent=2), flush=True)
    summary_path = OUT / ("summary.json" if names == ["tinyporto", "fluid"] else "controls.json")
    summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")

import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
validation={}
for name in ["tinyporto-basic", "fluid"]:
    texts={}
    hashes={}
    for version in ["before", "after"]:
        path=BASE / version / f"{name}.spv"
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val", str(path)],check=True)
        asm=subprocess.check_output(["spirv-dis", "--raw-id", str(path)],text=True)
        (BASE/version/f"{name}.spvasm").write_text(asm)
        texts[version]=asm.splitlines()
        hashes[version]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    def normalize(lines):
        result=[]
        for line in lines:
            match=re.fullmatch(r'(\s*OpEntryPoint \w+ %\d+ "[^"]*")(.*)',line)
            if match:
                line=match[1]+" "+" ".join(sorted(match[2].split()))
            result.append(line)
        return result
    differences=sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(texts["before"],texts["after"]))
    equal=normalize(texts["before"])==normalize(texts["after"])
    suffix="rs" if name=="tinyporto-basic" else "wynhost"
    host_equal=(BASE/"before"/f"{name}.{suffix}").read_bytes()==(BASE/"after"/f"{name}.{suffix}").read_bytes()
    validation[name]={"spirv_val": "passed for before and after", "sha256":hashes, "same_spirv_except_entrypoint_interface_order":equal,"differing_disassembly_lines":differences,"line_counts":{k:len(v) for k,v in texts.items()},"host_identical":host_equal}
    print(name,validation[name])
    assert equal, f"Unexpected shader change in {name}"
    assert host_equal, f"Unexpected host change in {name}"
(BASE/"validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(validation,indent=2)+"\n")
